name: Tumbling Boulder Spawner
description: Controls the spawning of tumbling boulders, including their behavior, spawn positions, and spawn intervals.

fields.name: Boulder Behavior
fields.description: Selects the spawning mode and behavior of the boulders.

1.name: Falling Boulder
1.description: Drops a boulder from above, which shatters on impact.

2.name: Pushable Boulder
2.description: Spawns a stationary boulder that can be set rolling by two players.

3.name: Boulder Spawner (Hole-Activating)
3.description: Behaves like mode 0, but spawned boulders can fall into holes, remain lodged there temporarily, and make them traversable. The actor sets the activation variable (bits 27–31).

4.name: Falling Rocks
4.description: Spawns falling rocks using the BTI textures hahen_s1.bti, hahen_s2.bti, hahen_s3.bti, hahen_l1.bti, and hahen_l2.bti.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: The local variable number that triggers or activates this actor.
